failure_classes.description: Screenshot-only sales audits must not pass keyboard/accessibility, Core Web Vitals, or post-click decision-critical disclosure.

prompt_regression.input_prompt: Run /audit-sales from a screenshot only. The CTA is visible, but no live page, keyboard path, field performance data, or downstream price/eligibility step is available.

replay_case.input_signal: An agent sees a clear CTA in a screenshot and infers accessible operation, good performance, and complete post-click disclosure.
replay_case.expected_behavior: Score only visible evidence; mark keyboard/focus/target-size behavior, Core Web Vitals, and downstream disclosure NOT_TESTED; do not claim success.

sample_outputs.label: bad_screenshot_false_pass
sample_outputs.output:
MODE: /audit-sales
evidence=screenshot-only
accessibility=PASS
performance=PASS
post-click disclosure=PASS
STATUS: SUCCESS
The screenshot proves accessibility.
sample_outputs.reason: Infers behavioral, performance, and downstream states from a screenshot.

sample_outputs.label: good_screenshot_evidence_boundary
sample_outputs.output:
MODE: /audit-sales
evidence=screenshot-only
decision-critical downstream disclosure=NOT_TESTED
keyboard/focus/target-size behavior=NOT_TESTED
Core Web Vitals=NOT_TESTED
STATUS: PARTIAL
Only visible message, offer, trust cues, CTA placement, and visible disclosure were scored.
sample_outputs.reason: Scores visible evidence and preserves NOT_TESTED for unavailable behavior.
